title: MODULAR TECHNIQUES FOR SYNTHETIC LONG-CONTEXT DATA GENERATION IN LANGUAGE MODEL TRAINING AND EVALUATION

bias_targets.methodology: Running lightweight post-generation probes that induce and diagnose social bias using emotional triggers and stereotype knowledge graphs (EBP; BiasKG).
Probing implicit and explicit caste associations signaled by surnames and personas using persona-based scenario probes (SWAT/PSAT).
Evaluating name- and persona-linked disparities using name-audit style checks to measure differential treatment based on demographic proxies.
Mitigating U.S.-centric bias by generating scenarios grounded in diverse, non-U.S. locations and evaluating cultural and geopolitical risks using LLM-based policy adherence filters.
